\]

\[
(x+b)(x-c)+(x-a)(x-c)+(x-a)(x+b)=0.
\]

\[
3x^2+2(b-a-c)x+(ac-ab-bc)=0.
\]

\[

\]
So the equation becomes
\[
3x^2-6\sqrt3\,x-3=0.
\]
Divide by \(3\):
\[
x^2-2\sqrt3\,x-1=0.
\]
Thus
\[
x=\frac{2\sqrt3\pm\sqrt{12+4}}2
=\frac{2\sqrt3\pm4}2
=\sqrt3\pm2.
\]
